description: This file defines the TimedObjectActivator class for managing timed actions (activate, deactivate, destroy, reload level) on game objects within Unity, including custom inspector GUI code for editing entries in the Unity Editor.

classes.name: TimedObjectActivator
classes.description: A MonoBehaviour that performs actions (activate, deactivate, destroy, reload level) on target game objects after specified delays.

classes.name: EntriesDrawer
classes.description: Custom property drawer for editing TimedObjectActivator.Entries in the Unity Editor, allowing adding, removing, and sorting entries based on delay.

methods.name: Awake
methods.description: Initializes and executes actions on entries based on their specified delay and action type.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Coroutine that activates a target game object after a delay.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Coroutine that deactivates a target game object after a delay.

methods.name: ReloadLevel
methods.description: Coroutine that reloads the current scene after a delay.

methods.name: OnGUI
methods.description: Draws custom inspector GUI for editing entries, including add, delete, and sort functionalities.

methods.name: GetPropertyHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of the custom inspector GUI based on the number of entries.
